title: A single extended left external Cech cup component
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], f:X→Spec k and g:Y→Spec k quasi-compact schemes [def-pc-scheme], F any X-module and G any Y-module. For the tensor and product Cech models [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-left-cech-exact], there exists a single cochain map c:T(F)→P(F). On every nonnegative (p,q) pure tensor and product tuple its coordinate is exactly the Alexander–Whitney tensor of the first-projection pullback of the front F section and second-projection pullback of the back G section, with faces and section pullbacks from [lem-sc-picard-right-cech-cup-construction]. This predicate is IsPicardLeftCechCupComponent. Neither naturality in F nor a natural transformation is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0BED, equation-kunneth-on-cech and following coefficient diagram; Cohomology Tags 01FD and 07MB. Official pages https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BED and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07MB read.

proof.text: Take the already stated natural-index external cup component for the finite affine open families.

Apply the tensor-total extension comparison to the two scalar Cech complexes. Compose this comparison with the extension of the natural-index cup component. The extension-map component formula cancels the target extension isomorphism, and the comparison coordinates identify the source pure tensor with its natural-index inclusion. Apply the existing component coordinate formula; picardCechFunctor and picardScalarCechFunctor are definitionally the same, as are the product opens and section pullbacks.

lean.statement:
theorem picardLeftCechCupComponent_exists
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y] (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) :
    ∃ c : (picardLeftTensorCechFunctor f g G).obj F ⟶
      (picardLeftProductCechFunctor f g G).obj F,
      IsPicardLeftCechCupComponent f g F G c
